# secureaccess_do_not_decrypt_list (Resource)

This resource manages a Do Not Decrypt List. The destinations are read from the destination list behind it, only the destinations of the configuration are managed: one that is removed outside of Terraform is detected, one that is added outside of it is not. The applications are read from the exception application list behind the Do Not Decrypt List (see `application_exception_list_id`): if `applications` is set in the configuration, an application that is added outside of Terraform is detected, and it cannot be removed again because the API does not allow it (after `terraform import` the applications of the list have to be listed in the configuration). The Secure Access API returns the content categories in a different form than they are written, therefore changes made to them outside of Terraform are not detected and they are not populated by `terraform import`. Applications and content categories can be added to an existing list, but not removed: the API does not allow it. A configuration that removes them is rejected on apply, replace the list instead (`terraform apply -replace=<resource address>`), which creates a new list with a new id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_do_not_decrypt_list" "example" {
  name = "my_do_not_decrypt_list"
  destinations = [
    {
      destination = "example.com"
      comment     = "This is a comment for the destination."
    }
  ]
  applications                 = [101]
  decrypt_exception_categories = [12]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Do Not Decrypt List.

### Optional

- `applications` (Set of Number) IDs of the applications that are excluded from decryption. They can be added to an existing list, but not removed. They are read from the exception application list behind the Do Not Decrypt List.
- `decrypt_exception_categories` (Set of Number) IDs of the content categories that are excluded from decryption. They can be added to an existing list, but not removed.
- `destinations` (Attributes Set) Destinations that are excluded from decryption, domain names (in lowercase), IPv4 addresses or CIDR blocks. URLs are not supported. Large lists are split into multiple requests automatically. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations))

### Read-Only

- `application_exception_list_id` (Number) Id of the exception application list that holds the applications of the Do Not Decrypt List, the `id` of the `secureaccess_application_exception_list` data source. It is 0 while the list has no applications (the API answered null to the create request and 0 to an update that added only content categories, a null is read as 0), and the data source cannot read a list with the id 0, so guard a reference to it with `count`.
- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `is_default` (Boolean) Specifies whether this is the default Do Not Decrypt List.
- `total_applications` (Number) Number of applications in the Do Not Decrypt List.
- `total_domains` (Number) Number of domains in the Do Not Decrypt List.
- `total_ips` (Number) Number of IP addresses in the Do Not Decrypt List.

<a id="nestedatt--destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destinations`

Required:

- `destination` (String) The destination value, a domain name in lowercase, an IPv4 address or an IPv4 CIDR block. URLs, whitespace and a trailing dot are not allowed.

Optional:

- `comment` (String) Comment for the destination.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_do_not_decrypt_list.example "<id>"
```
